entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
Certainly, I can help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
It's Sarah Miller, order 788-12554B.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. I don't want it.
I see. It looks like it was delivered a bit over a month ago. Can I ask what's changed since then?
I've been a little preoccupied. My brother was scheduled for deployment, but right before he left there was a family emergency.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright.
He ended up in the hospital and needed emergency surgery. So, no, I wasn't prioritizing returning your wristband.
Of course, I completely understand. My apologies. Let me just double-check the return policy for that item. Please hold one moment.
Whatever.
Thank you for your patience, Sarah. I've just checked our system. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Since you're at day 39, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh. I was prepared for a fight. How surprisingly competent.

I'm happy I could make it easy for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and you can drop it off with any mail carrier.
Fine. I'll look for it.
Great. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued back to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. That's it. Goodbye.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope your brother has a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
